title: Every Black Friday Sports Tech Deal – The Big List!
content:
It’s that time of year again. Most brands have already put out their best deals of the year!

Virtually everything is now announced, and really the only wildcard here is if Uncle Amazon decides to randomly discount something for a few hours without authorization from the company (great for us consumers!). That tends to happen for slightly older things, but sometimes even newer things. Either way, if you see a deal you like, grab it now in case it disappears. You can always return/swap/whatever later (all the way till January in Amazon’s case).

As always, I’m constantly updating these deals hourly over the Black Friday weekend. Note: If you want a more simplified view of just the Garmin deals, there’s this page that filters that (still giant) list down a bit.

Update – Friday, Nov 27th Mid-Day: Here are the most popular deals (in terms of what you’ve bought thus far). Here’s the Top 10 ranking:

  1. 1. Garmin Fenix 9 for $100 off (and $150 for 43mm!): Technically, you’re buying slightly more Fenix 9 Pro units than Fenix 9 base units, but either way, with the new sale started a few days ago, that easily took the lead on what y’all are buying the most. And I’d agree, given it’s brand and the best sports watch on the market, $100 makes it an easier choice (bringing the base down to $899, and the Pro at $999). The 43mm base Fenix 9 is down to $849 ($150 off!)
  2. 2. DJI NEO 1 drone for $139: No surprise here, and this has moved into the 2nd place spot. This is a fantastic deal if you want a simple follow-me drone that’s virtually impossible to kill no matter the number of crashes. Trust me, I’ve tried. It’s perfect for sports, or kids.
  3. 3. Garmin Fenix 8 at $749: With flashlight, ECG, diving features, and then virtually all the new software features coming from the Fenix 9, it’s pretty much impossible to beat this. It was in the #1 spot above, before the new Fenix 9 sale started.
  4. 4. Garmin Varia RearView 820 at $249: This is $50 off, and I didn’t exactly think it’d make the Top 5 list, but here we are. It’s a solid new unit, and easily the best/most accurate radar on the market, especially with some of the firmware/Edge tweaks since release making it a bit less noisy.
  5. 5. Garmin Fenix 8 Pro at $849: This is $150 off the regular price, and also $150 cheaper than the base Fenix 9 unit, but with the ‘Pro’ name here, you get LTE & Satellite messaging. Plus virtually all those new Fenix 9 software features. It’s a good compromise between Fenix 8 and Fenix 9.
  6. 6. Wahoo KICKR CORE 2 at $399: This is a fantastic deal for a smart trainer, and I’d strongly recommend this if you’re in the market for one. It doesn’t really get any better than this price-wise. Note: Amazon has gone out of stock here, but REI still has it!
  7. 7. Amazfit Active Max for $119: At that price, it’s such a bargain. It’s got offline maps, a big beautiful display, a million sport modes and more. Sure, it doesn’t have the polish of Garmin or other brands…but it’s a great place to start.
  8. 8. Garmin Varia RTL-515 Radar for $149: This thing’s been around the block a lot, but it’s also the 2nd best radar on the market after the 820 up above. And it’s $100 cheaper. It still beats every other 3rd party radar on the market.
  9. 9. Apple Airpod Pro 3 at $149: These are my go-to headphones for both sport and non-sport usage. This is the lowest price they’ve ever been, and the optical HR in these units is really darn good (as is the audio). These are also my wife’s go-to headphones as well.
  10. 10. Apple AirTags 4-Pack for $79 (2nd Gen): I can’t even begin to count how many AirTags I have these days. Every bag that I travel with for sure, plus most city/etc bikes, sometimes a kid.

Personally, I think the Wahoo BOLT 3 ($227), Wahoo ROAM 3, and KICKR CORE 2 deals are also incredibly strong, but…above are what people are buying the last few days. I’ll update this as the sales progress.

Need help deciding? Check out my guides and Gear I Use lists:

  • GPS Watch Buyers Guide (just published)
  • Smart Trainer Buyers Guide (just published)
  • Action Cam & Drone Buyers Guide (just published)
  • DC RAINMAKER Gear I Actually Use List (just updated)
  • The Girl’s Gear I Actually Use List (my wife’s list – just updated)

With that, on to the deals! And thanks for supporting the site via the links below. As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases. Enjoy!
